name: flow_official_server_from_net_json
description: The official server is data/net.json's (design 6.11): its wss:// URL is Session.official_address, what Join's Official row shows (the host) and goes to, and what a bare code joins on; Nearby and typed addresses keep the address rule. The hub's first opening prints one banner line with project.godot's version, data/build.json's build (0 for a local run) and that server, which a release's boot check reads from the exported game.

steps.msg: the official server's URL, from data/net.json
the banner: name, version, build and official server
project.godot carries config/version, X.Y.Z (the release gate holds tags to it)
the host as the hub shows it, the protocol's own port left out
Join's Official row names the official server
typed addresses keep the address rule
the row shows the official address as it stands when the panel opens (here the loopback's)
Go on the Official row connects there, online, and makes a party
